me.join.statement: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO members(user_id, display, role, joined_at) VALUES(?1, ?2, 'member', ?3)

me.get.statement: SELECT user_id, display, role FROM members WHERE user_id = ?1 LIMIT 1

members.list.statement: SELECT display, role FROM members ORDER BY joined_at LIMIT 200

books.list.statement: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.cover_file_id, b.status, b.meets_on, m.display AS proposer FROM books b LEFT JOIN members m ON m.user_id = b.proposed_by ORDER BY CASE b.status WHEN 'current' THEN 0 WHEN 'proposed' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, b.created_at DESC LIMIT 200

books.propose.statement: INSERT INTO books(title, author, cover_file_id, proposed_by, status, created_at) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, 'proposed', ?5 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?4)

books.schedule.guard: Only an organizer can schedule a meeting, and the book must still be on the shortlist.
books.schedule.statement: UPDATE books SET status = 'current', meets_on = ?2 WHERE id = ?1 AND status <> 'finished' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?3 AND role = 'organizer')

books.finish.guard: Only an organizer can mark the current book as finished.
books.finish.statement: UPDATE books SET status = 'finished' WHERE id = ?1 AND status = 'current' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?2 AND role = 'organizer')

books.remove.guard: Only an organizer can remove a book.
books.remove.statement: DELETE FROM books WHERE id = ?1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?2 AND role = 'organizer')

notes.add.statement: INSERT INTO notes(user_id, book_id, file_id, name, created_at) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM books WHERE id = ?2) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE user_id = ?1)

notes.mine.statement: SELECT n.id, n.book_id, n.file_id, n.name, n.created_at, b.title AS book FROM notes n JOIN books b ON b.id = n.book_id WHERE n.user_id = ?1 ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
